m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Your petty magics are naught compared to the tendrils of power at my command!
<ITALICS>As the Spider Witch fades, she leaves behind a glittering pair of Elephant-sized Bracelets. </ITALICS>
A so-called Wizard, hurmph. You're not even worth me sharpening my tusks.
<ITALICS>You discover a chest containing the Queen's Robes. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You find a sparkling Ring amongst the goo. With a quick polish on your robe, it's good as new... Ick. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>The Shadow-Weaver had the Queen's tusk ornaments in a small silk pouch. </ITALICS>
You retrieved all of my relics. Amazing!
Morganthe's agents plundered my tomb to disrupt my focus. They are up to no good, and my own wards keep us out!
However, if you can collect my grave items that they scattered, it will give me the power to open the way.
Go to the lesser tombs and battle Morganthe's agents for my Bracelets, Robes, Ring, and Tusk Ornaments.
Go to the four lesser tombs and battle our foes to recover my Bracelets, Robes, Ring, and Tusk Ornaments.
